# Assets · Logos

2 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for ywc21-logo-glow.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Official YWC21 marks (transparent PNG). Never recolour, redraw or crop the zodiac ring.

- `ywc21-logo-glow.png` — hero mark with built-in celestial-blue halo; use only on `surface` night (navy). 1230×1025.
- `ywc21-logo-compass-st.png` — standard mark, logo-gold with compass-slate star; works on navy and parchment. 488×319.
- `ywc21-logo-compass-th.png` — same mark reading "21th" (typo, should be 21st). Kept for reference; do not publish.

Clear space: at least the height of the "ST" superscript on every side. Minimum width: 120px.
